internal.title: High Error Rate Incident in Checkout Service
internal.body:
On 2026-11-08 starting at 11:53 UTC, the checkout service experienced a high error rate (95%) and elevated latency (p95 ~400 ms). Initial diagnosis pointed to error injection within the checkout service. Attempts to mitigate by disabling the cartFailure flag and restarting the service were blocked by guardrails due to dry_run_missing and target_mismatch issues. The incident was escalated for further investigation and resolution.

Timeline highlights:
- 11:53:02 Alert received
- 12:12:44 Diagnosis round 1: error injection hypothesis
- 12:12:51 Proposal refused: dry_run_missing, target_mismatch
- 12:12:54 Replanned hypothesis
- 12:12:59 Diagnosis round 2
- 12:13:02 Proposal refused: dry_run_missing
- 12:13:04 Replanned hypothesis
- 12:13:09 Diagnosis round 3
- 12:13:16 Proposal refused: target_mismatch

Further actions are pending escalation.

external.body: Between 11:53 and 12:15 UTC on 2026-11-08, some customers experienced errors when attempting to complete checkout. Our team identified elevated error rates and latency in the checkout service and is actively investigating the root cause. We are working to resolve the issue as quickly as possible and apologize for any inconvenience caused.
